correction: The first parser read gap rows with a tab IFS and checked only the fixed string. A tab IFS merges empty fields, so `id<TAB><TAB>url` took the URL as the fixed string; a blank fixed string matched every apt error; rows without a tracking URL, with a non-https URL or with a 4th field were accepted. Every row must have exactly 3 nonempty tab-separated fields and an https URL, validated before any classification.
evidence: Cross-review (openai/gpt-6.1-sol) of b99d50a, finding 1. test/forky-known-gaps-test.sh: with the old parser 7 of 21 cases fail (malformed row on failure and success, no URL, empty and blank fixed string, non-https URL, 4th field). The last-row-without-newline cases passed already: grep -v added the newline.
